summary: This Dockerfile creates a Docker image based on PHP 8.2 with Apache web server, copies your application code into the web root directory, configures PHP to use production settings, and switches to running as the www-data user for security.

explanations.3: This copies all files from your current directory on your computer into /var/www/html, which is the standard location Apache serves web files from.
explanations.5: This renames the production-ready PHP configuration file (php.ini-production) to the active configuration name (php.ini) so Apache uses those production settings instead of development defaults.
explanations.7: This switches the user context so that when the container runs, processes execute as 'www-data' (a non-root user) rather than root, which is a security best practice.
